name: PETMAN
summary: A DARPA-funded anthropomorphic robot built by Boston Dynamics to test chemical-protection suits by moving like a soldier — walking, squatting, crawling and even simulating sweat inside a sealed chamber. Its dynamically balancing hydraulic biped hardware was the direct predecessor of Atlas.
notable: First anthropomorphic robot to walk dynamically balanced with a natural human gait
Boston Dynamics was founded in 1992 by Marc Raibert out of the MIT Leg Laboratory; PETMAN's balance control descends directly from the Leg Lab's hopping and running machines
